method: Exact intersections with catalog locationPolygon footprints. Spanish SHP Polygon/MultiPolygon rings and holes preserved, EPSG:32630 transformed to EPSG:4326 with always_xy; coastal zones limited to isCoastal destinations. BG identifiers and FR normalized department names joined to NUTS3; LT county names joined to named NUTS3 counties. GR uses reviewed catalog jurisdictions; HR/PT reuse reviewed national mapping artifacts. EMMA_ID codes are joined by exact feed area names and are distinct from boundary identifiers. Empty locationIds are reviewed catalog-external regions.
